# Flying the scout

The scout finally has a flame, and 1.1 gives it a repaint. The hull is cleaner, the cockpit is brighter and the thruster has four frames instead of two.

![The scout](../images/scout.png)

| Ship | Hull | Cargo |
|---|---|---|
| Scout | 40 | 2 t |
| Hauler | 120 | 24 t |
| Interceptor | 60 | 1 t |

Next up: the stations.
